verdict.rationale: The manual states 'Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.' This plausibly refers to pull requests created from the device on hosted platforms, but the excerpt never names its antecedent. Related items show hosting-provider integration (listing repos, Connect with GitHub/BitBucket, GitHub Enterprise/GitLab/Gitea instances), which supports the platform side but is not itself PR creation. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming pull-request creation, details of the PR workflow (title, description, base/compare branch selection), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create pull requests on hosted Git platforms directly from my device

citations.quote: Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.
